confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

user.description: Select the SkyRC charger to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Passcode needed
reauth_confirm.description:
{name} is refusing the passcode Home Assistant sends, and is showing the one it wants on its own display. Read the four digits off the charger and enter them here.

This is why the charger shows a PASSCODE screen while Home Assistant polls it. If you would rather not use a passcode at all, clear it in the SkyCharger app, or turn off "Read the program of a running channel" in this integration's options.

error.invalid_passcode: The passcode is the four digits the charger shows on its own display.

abort.no_devices_found: No SkyRC chargers found in Bluetooth range. Make sure the charger is powered on and near a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.reauth_successful: The passcode was saved and the charger reloaded.

data.poll_program: Read the program of a running channel

data_description.passcode: The four-digit passcode set in the SkyCharger app. Leave it at 0000 if you have not set one. If the charger shows PASSCODE on its display while Home Assistant polls it, those are the digits it wants — read them off the screen and enter them here.
data_description.poll_program: Reads each running channel's battery type and program, which is what tells charging apart from discharging. It is the only query that carries the passcode, so turning it off stops the charger prompting for one — at the cost of the direction for runs Home Assistant did not start itself.

error.invalid_passcode: The passcode is the four digits the charger shows on its own display.

start_program.name: Start program
start_program.description: Runs a charge program on one channel. Anything left out is taken from that channel's staged settings, except that naming a different battery type or program starts from that program's defaults.

battery_type.name: Battery type
battery_type.description: Chemistry of the pack on the channel.

program.name: Program
program.description: What to run. Which programs are valid depends on the battery type.

cell_count.name: Cell count
cell_count.description: Cells in series: up to 6 for lithium, 15 for nickel, 10 for lead acid.

charge_voltage.name: Charge voltage per cell
charge_voltage.description: Target charge voltage per cell, in mV. The charger's own 'Condition' setting.

discharge_voltage.name: Discharge voltage per cell
discharge_voltage.description: Cut-off voltage per cell, in mV. For a storage program this is the storage target.

track_voltage.name: Peak sensitivity
track_voltage.description: Delta-peak detection threshold in mV, for nickel packs only.

cycle_number.name: Cycle count
cycle_number.description: How many charge/discharge cycles to run, for a nickel cycle program.

cycle_order.name: Cycle order
cycle_order.description: Whether a cycle program charges first or discharges first.

repeak_number.name: Re-peak count
repeak_number.description: How many times to re-peak a nickel pack.

save_preset.name: Save preset
save_preset.description: Saves what a channel has staged — battery type, program, cell count, currents and voltages — as a preset that any channel can be set to later. Saving over an existing name replaces it.

delete_preset.name: Delete preset
delete_preset.description: Deletes a saved preset. Presets belong to the charger, so any of its selects will do.
